newsitem.title: UK: Guardian up in strong insurance sector.
newsitem.headline: Guardian up in strong insurance sector.

text.p: Shares in Guardian Royal Exchange Plc rose in a strong composite insurance sector on Tuesday as the sector recovered from recent underperformance, traders and analysts said.
Guardian shares rose 12p to 275p by 1308 GMT, Commercial Union Plc advanced 18-1/2p to 674-1/2p and General Accident Plc gained 10-1/2p to 741p.
"We have seen a period of underperformance from the composites and now marketmakers are marking prices higher to cover bear positions," said one sales trader.
The composite sector has underperformed the FT Allshare index for the majority of the last five months of this year and some analysts believe the sector is due a re-rating.
